caption: NAHB/Wells Fargo Housing Market Index (HMI) (vermillion, left axis — a bounded 0–100 diffusion index with 50 = neutral, dashed line) against the SPY price (blue, right axis), 1985–2025. Sentiment swings are dramatic — record low 8 in Jan-2009, record 90 in Nov-2020 — but they move WITH or AFTER equities, not ahead of them (SPY→HMI Granger significant at all 12 lags; HMI→SPY at lag 5 only). Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Hero shows the bounded-index 50-neutral convention and the reverse-causality framing from Evan's Granger verdict; record-low/record-high values re-read from the dataset at generation time.
